lead.headline: Rice still has not practised; the Week 7 bye just got bigger
lead.deck: Reid will not commit to Rice. Strange replaced Loveland overnight, so Jacksonville's bye now takes four of your starters.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice did not practise Wednesday, and Andy Reid, who called him 'feeling better', would not commit to Thursday, Friday or Sunday. Saquon Barkley's Wednesday was no better; Sirianni is only 'hopeful'. Both lineup calls stay where they were: Rice into the flex for Pickens only if active at 12:55 Sunday, Barkley for Tuten only if Friday's report clears him, because Tuten kicks off at Wembley two hours before Barkley's inactives. The tight-end seat changed hands again at 23:13 UTC: Brenton Strange in, Colston Loveland out. It is a coin flip this week, and Strange has drawn eight targets in each of his last two games — but it puts a fourth Jaguar in your lineup, and Jacksonville are on bye in Week 7. Jason Myers kicks tonight at Denver and stays. ESPN has the game at 53%.
